text: Which side am I if I'm 'the Khalifa'?
query: SELECT VALUE name FROM faction WHERE player_role CONTAINS "Khalifa";
answer: The Dervish side: the Khalifa, Abdullah the Taiasha, rules the Dervishes (§1.1).

text: Can four of us play? How do we split the armies?
answer: Yes: each player takes command of one or more Dervish tribes or Anglo-Egyptian brigades (§1.1).

text: If I'm commanding the Hadendowa only, which leader goes with my units?
answer: The Hadendowa units and their leader, Osman Digna (§1.1 command by tribe; §9.112 names him their leader).
note: Part B's question asked 'whose units can I touch'; the manual only says commands split by tribe, so the query returns the tribe's leader.

text: What historical day is this battle?
answer: September 2nd, 1898 (§1.1).

text: We're new. Which scenario do we start with?
answer: Play FALL OF KHARTOUM and the historical scenario first, then the campaign game (§1.1).

text: Is this a beginner's game?
expect: Not strictly a beginner's game; mechanics familiar to players of modest experience.
answer: Not strictly, but the mechanics should be familiar to players of modest experience (§1.1).

text: The counter says 'Taiasha' but my book says 'Ta'aisha'. Same thing?
expect: English spellings of Arabic names are transliterations and vary by source.
answer: Yes: English spellings of Arabic names are transliterations and vary widely by source (§1.1).

text: Why don't the tribe names match Wikipedia?
query: SELECT VALUE id FROM rule WHERE section = section:`1.1` AND statement CONTAINS "transliteration";
answer: Spellings are transliterations and vary with source, author and date (§1.1).

text: How far is one hex in yards?
answer: Approximately 400–440 yards (§1.2).

text: How much real time passes each turn?
answer: Two hours per day turn (§1.2).

text: How many men does this battalion counter represent?
answer: Between 400 and 700 men per infantry or cavalry counter (§1.2).

text: Is each gunboat counter a single boat or a flotilla?
answer: A single boat: each gunboat present at the battle has its own counter (§1.2).

text: Why can a Dervish leader fight but Kitchener can't?
query: RETURN [fn::allowed(unit:osman_digna, action:melee_attack), fn::allowed(unit:kitchener, action:melee_attack), fn::allowed(unit:kitchener, action:fire)];
answer: Dervish leader counters include their retinues (§1.2) and have fire, melee and movement factors (§6.51); Anglo-Egyptian leaders have a movement factor only.

text: There's a big 'K' on this hex. Does it matter in the campaign game?
answer: No: the lettered hexes are set-up hexes for the historical scenario only (§2.1).

text: Do the Zariba trenches count in the campaign game?
answer: No, they are clear terrain unless the Anglo-Egyptian player constructs them (§2.1, §5.3).

text: My unit wants to move onto the scattergram drawing. Is that a legal hex?
answer: Yes: all full hexes are playable, including the seven scattergram hexes (§2.1).

text: Where's the Terrain Effects Chart?
answer: At the top of the mapsheet (§2.1).

text: Where's the CRT?
expect: lower right corner of the Omdurman mapsheet
answer: With the Combat Tables in the lower right corner of the mapsheet (§2.1); the back cover also carries it with the explanation of results.

text: Why is there a gap in Khartoum's wall?
expect: washed away by the receding White Nile after the flood
answer: That stretch was washed away by the receding White Nile after the flood (§2.1).

text: How do the two maps line up?
answer: The Khartoum map's north edge abuts the middle portion of the Omdurman map's south edge (§2.1).

text: Is Khartoum in play during the campaign game?
answer: No: the campaign uses the Omdurman map; Khartoum lay in ruins in 1898 (§2.1, §9.1).

text: Which table tells me if terrain slows me down?
query: SELECT VALUE name FROM component WHERE purpose CONTAINS "effect of each type on movement";
answer: The Terrain Effects Chart (§2.2).

text: Which table tells me if I can see the target?
answer: The Line of Sight Table on the back of the rulebook (§2.2).

text: Where are range effects listed?
query: SELECT VALUE name FROM component WHERE purpose CONTAINS "range effects";
answer: In the Combat Tables, which also include the Combat Results Table (§2.2).

text: Can I fire at a unit I can't see?
query: SELECT VALUE id FROM rule WHERE kind = "prohibition" AND actions CONTAINS action:direct_fire;
answer: Not with direct fire: blocked line of sight prevents direct fire attacks (§2.2, §6.3); howitzer fire is the exception (§6.64).

text: Which range line does my fort use?
answer: The artillery line of the Dervish Range Effects Table (§2.31).

text: Can my Baggara fire at all?
query: RETURN { may_fire: fn::allowed(tribe:baggara, action:fire), weapon: fn::lines(tribe:baggara).weapon.name };
answer: They are armed with spears and swords (§2.31); every non-leader unit has a printed fire factor, but their real strength is melee.
note: Part B said 'spears and swords only'; the manual gives every Dervish combat unit a fire factor (sample counter, §6.51), so firing is not forbidden.

text: Is Isa Zachneih a rifle unit?
answer: Yes, it fires on the rifles line (§2.31).

text: Can Osman Digna shoot?
query: RETURN { may_fire: fn::allowed(unit:osman_digna, action:fire), weapon: fn::lines(unit:osman_digna).weapon.name };
answer: Yes: Dervish leaders have a fire factor (§6.51) and are armed with spears and swords (§2.31).

text: Which line does the Sultan use?
answer: Any of the Howitzer, Artillery and Maxims lines (§2.32).

text: Does an old gunboat have Maxims?
answer: No: old gunboats fire on the Artillery line only (§2.32).

text: Do the Friendlies use our rifle line?
answer: No: they fire rifles on the Dervish Range Effects Table (§2.32 → §6.52).

text: What range line does the Camel Corps use?
answer: Rifles: every Anglo-Egyptian unit except gunboats, Maxims, artillery and leaders is armed with rifles (§2.32).

text: Which number on the counter is melee?
answer: The middle one: fire combat factor, melee, movement (§2.3; 21 Lancers 8·5·15).

text: What does '10/16' on a gunboat mean?
answer: Movement upstream / downstream (§2.3, §5.24).

text: What's the '6×2' on the Sultan?
answer: Maxim guns of factor 6 that fire twice per turn (§2.3).

text: Where's the brigade ID on my infantry?
answer: Printed on the counter (upper right corner, §5.54); the sample counter belongs to the 4th Egyptian brigade (§2.3).

text: Kitchener is 0·0·15. So he has no fire or melee at all?
answer: Right: Anglo-Egyptian leaders have a movement factor only (§2.3, §6.51).

text: What kind of die do we use?
answer: One ten-sided die (§2.4).

text: Where's the reinforcement schedule?
query: SELECT VALUE name FROM component WHERE kind = "card";
expect: Campaign Game Order of Appearance Card
answer: On the Campaign Game Order of Appearance Card (§2.4); §9.112–9.113 give it in the rules.

text: How many player turns make a game turn?
query: RETURN count(SELECT id FROM phase WHERE kind = "player_turn" AND parent = phase:game_turn);

text: Who goes first?
query: SELECT VALUE [name, moves_first.name] FROM scenario ORDER BY name;
answer: It depends on the scenario: the Anglo-Egyptian player in the campaign game, the Dervish player in the historical scenario and FALL OF KHARTOUM (§4, §9.113, §9.212, §9.322).

text: I just moved next to his spearmen. Who shoots first?
answer: The Dervish player, with defensive fire, before your offensive fire (§4 A, §6.4).

text: When do my howitzers fire on my own turn?
query: SELECT VALUE [out.name, out.step] FROM allowed_in WHERE in = action:howitzer_fire AND out.player_turn = faction:anglo_egyptian;
expect: Maxim Second Fire and Howitzer Fire Subphase (Anglo-Egyptian offensive)
answer: In the Maxim Second Fire and Howitzer Fire Subphase, after all direct fire (§4 A, §6.42).

text: Do I melee before or after shooting?
answer: After: melee is the last phase of your player turn (§4).

text: Does the Dervish player get to melee during my turn?
query: SELECT VALUE actor.name FROM phase WHERE player_turn = faction:anglo_egyptian AND name CONTAINS "Melee";
answer: No: only the moving player melee attacks (§4).

text: Do my Maxims get two shots when he's attacking me?
query: SELECT VALUE out.name FROM allowed_in WHERE in = action:maxim_second_fire AND out.fire_mode = "defensive";
expect: Maxim Second Fire and Howitzer Fire Subphase (Anglo-Egyptian defensive)
answer: Yes: Anglo-Egyptian defensive fire has both the direct and the Maxim second fire subphases (§4 B).

text: Can my gunboats use howitzers during his turn?
query: RETURN { phases: (SELECT VALUE out.name FROM allowed_in WHERE in = action:howitzer_fire AND out.fire_mode = "defensive"), night: state:night->prohibits->action CONTAINS action:howitzer_fire };

phases: Maxim Second Fire and Howitzer Fire Subphase (Anglo-Egyptian defensive)

answer: Yes, in defensive fire, but not on night turns (§4 B, §6.64).

text: Can the Dervish shoot twice with anything?
query: SELECT VALUE name FROM phase WHERE actor = faction:dervish AND step IN [3, 5];
answer: Not in a second subphase: only the Anglo-Egyptian player has the Maxim/howitzer subphase (§4, §6.42).
note: 6.14 names 'gunboats' as an exception to firing once without saying which gunboats; see open_question:dervish_defensive_maxims.

text: If my defensive fire disrupts his units, can they still melee me?
answer: No: disrupted units may not melee (back cover), and they stay disrupted until the end of their own player turn.

text: When does the turn marker move?
query: RETURN { after: (SELECT VALUE name FROM phase WHERE parent = phase:game_turn AND ord < phase:end_of_game_turn.ord ORDER BY ord) };
answer: After both player turns are complete (§4 C).

text: How do we know when the game ends?
query: SELECT VALUE [name, length_turns] FROM scenario ORDER BY name;
answer: At the end of the scenario's length: 22 turns (campaign), 4 (historical), variable for FALL OF KHARTOUM (§4 C, §9.12, §9.22, §9.33).

text: What are the two sides?
query: SELECT VALUE name FROM faction ORDER BY name;
answer: The Anglo-Egyptian army and the Dervishes (§1.1).

text: Whom does the Anglo-Egyptian player play?
expect: Herbert Kitchener, Sirdar (CIC) of the Anglo-Egyptian army
answer: Herbert Kitchener, Sirdar of the Anglo-Egyptian army (§1.1).

text: How much territory does the Omdurman map cover?
answer: Approximately 100 square miles (§2.1).

text: How big is the Omdurman mapsheet?
What's in the box?
query: SELECT VALUE name FROM component WHERE section = section:`2.4`;
expect: Campaign Game Order of Appearance Card
answer: Two mapsheets, the rules booklet, a die-cut counter sheet, the Order of Appearance card, one ten-sided die and the box (§2.4).

text: What year does the Khartoum mini-map show?
Where is the Howitzer Fire Scattergram, and how many hexes does it have?
expect: lower right corner of the Omdurman mapsheet
answer: Lower right corner of the mapsheet; seven hexes, all playable (§2.1).

text: Which play aids are printed on the Omdurman map?
answer: Turn Record Track, Turn Sequence and Terrain Effects Chart at the top; Combat Tables and Howitzer Fire Scattergram lower right (§2.1).

text: Which units fire rifles on the Dervish Range Effects Table?
query: SELECT VALUE in FROM fires_on WHERE out = range_line:d_rifles;
answer: The Jehadia, the Danagla and Isa Zachneih (§2.31), plus the Anglo-Egyptian Friendlies (§6.52).

text: Which Anglo-Egyptian units fire on the Artillery line?
query: SELECT VALUE in FROM fires_on WHERE out = range_line:ae_artillery;
answer: Artillery, old gunboats and the named gunboats (§2.32).

text: What does '9·5·8' on an infantry counter mean?
answer: Fire combat factor 9, melee 5, movement 8 (§2.3).

text: What is the Royal Engineers' printed rating?
Who are the Dervish leaders?
query: SELECT VALUE name FROM unit WHERE class = unit_class:d_leader;
answer: The Khalifa Abdullah, Yakub, Sherif, Ali Wad Helu, Osman Digna and Sheik El Din (§9.111–9.112).

text: Who are the Anglo-Egyptian leaders?
query: SELECT VALUE name FROM unit WHERE class = unit_class:ae_leader;
answer: Kitchener, Gatacre and Hunter (campaign, §9.113), and Gordon (FALL OF KHARTOUM only, §9.321).

text: What is the 32 Battery's movement allowance?
How far can the Sultan steam downstream?
answer: 18 hexes (12 upstream) (§2.3, §5.24).

text: How many named gunboats are there?
answer: Five, the units with howitzer fire capability (§6.64).

text: Which Dervish tribes are in the game?
answer: Baggara, Jaalin, Danagla, Kehena, Degheim, Hadendowa, Mulazmin, Jehadia and Taiasha, plus the lone Isa Zachneih unit (§9.111–9.112).

text: What is the full order of a game turn in the campaign game?
expect: Maxim Second Fire and Howitzer Fire Subphase (Anglo-Egyptian offensive)
Maxim Second Fire and Howitzer Fire Subphase (Anglo-Egyptian defensive)
answer: Anglo-Egyptian movement, Dervish defensive fire, Anglo-Egyptian offensive fire (direct, then Maxim/howitzer), Anglo-Egyptian melee; then the Dervish turn mirrored with Anglo-Egyptian defensive fire in both subphases; then advance the marker (§4).

text: In the historical scenario, what is the very first phase of a game turn?
answer: The Dervish Movement Phase: the Dervish player moves first (§9.212).

text: What comes right after the Dervish movement phase?
answer: Anglo-Egyptian defensive fire, starting with its direct fire subphase (§4 B).

text: During the Anglo-Egyptian turn, how many fire subphases does the Dervish defensive fire have?
query: RETURN count(SELECT id FROM phase WHERE parent = phase:ae_turn_dervish_defensive_fire);
answer: One: the Dervish player executes only the direct fire subphase (6.41) (§6.4).

text: Who fires in the defensive fire step?
query: SELECT VALUE [player_turn.name, actor.name] FROM phase WHERE kind = "fire_step" AND fire_mode = "defensive" ORDER BY player_turn.name;
answer: The non-moving player: the Dervish in the Anglo-Egyptian turn and vice versa (§4, §6.7).

text: 4.C says to advance the marker 'to the next hour'. Is a turn one hour or two?
answer: Two hours per day turn (§1.2, and the track steps 6:00, 8:00, ...); 4.C's 'next hour' is a slip the corpus records as an inconsistency.

text: Who designed the game?
query: SELECT VALUE name FROM person WHERE role CONTAINS "game design";
answer: Peter Bertram (Credits).

text: How do I get a rules question answered?
query: RETURN rule:rcredits_questions.statement CONTAINS "yes or no" AND rule:rcredits_questions.statement CONTAINS "stamped, self-addressed envelope";
answer: Phrase it to be answered yes or no and enclose a stamped, self-addressed envelope (Credits).

text: Which sections does §2.1 refer to?
answer: 9.2 (the historical scenario's set-up hexes) and 5.3 (constructing the Zariba).

text: Which sections send me to §6.52 (the Friendlies)?
answer: §2.32 (Anglo-Egyptian weapons).

text: Which unit types does the Dervish weapons rule (2.31) concern?
answer: Dervish artillery, gunboats and forts (artillery line), Jehadia, Danagla and Isa Zachneih (rifles), and leaders (spears and swords) (§2.31).

text: What are the subsections of §2, Game Components?
query: SELECT VALUE num FROM section WHERE parent = section:`2` ORDER BY ord;
answer: 2.1 The Game Maps, 2.2 Play Aids, 2.3 The Units, 2.4 Game Parts Inventory.

text: What is inside the Combat Tables?
answer: The two Range Effects Tables and the Combat Results Table (§2.2).

text: Which rules involve the Line of Sight Table?
answer: 2.2 (what it does), 6.21 (check it first), 6.3 (how to read it) and 9.212 (historical Dervish set-up out of LOS).

text: What can happen in the Dervish movement phase?
answer: Movement, reinforcements entering the map, and (once, on the first campaign night turn) the desertion roll (§5, §9.112, §8.2).

text: Under which heading is the howitzer rule (6.64)?
answer: 6.6 Special Artillery Capabilities.

text: What kinds of unit is the Sultan, from specific to general?
answer: A new type (named) gunboat, a gunboat, a combat unit.
